title: U.S. Marine Staff Sgt. rescues civilians
description:
U.S. Marine Corps Staff Sgt. Nabeel Gootee, an all-source analyst with U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and Virginia native, recounts a story of aiding civilians during a flash flood while camping in Havasu Falls, Arizona, July 29, 2023. Gootee was awarded a Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal for his heroism. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Conor Ragland)
(This video contains music from USMC licensed assets from Adobe Stock: "Epic Spirit" by Osipov Vladimir/Jamendo and "Lockdown" by Burrow Beats)
keywords: MARFORPAC, Flood, INDOPACOM, Rescue, Physical Fitness, Award Ceremony
